title.en: A constant leak and a current disturbance

explanation.fa: Is it dripping? دربارهٔ وضعیت فعلی می‌پرسد. It drips all the time عادت یا مشکل تکراری را می‌گوید. is bothering me یعنی این صدا الان در این دوره اذیتم می‌کند، به‌ویژه شب‌ها.
explanation.en: Is it dripping? asks about the current situation. It drips all the time describes a repeated problem. Is bothering me focuses on the disturbance being experienced now, especially at night.

example.text: It drips all the time, and the sound is bothering me at night.

translation.fa: همیشه چکه می‌کند و صدایش شب‌ها اذیتم می‌کند.
translation.en: It drips all the time, and the sound is bothering me at night.

takeaway.fa: drips برای تکرار؛ is bothering برای آزار در این دوره.
takeaway.en: Drips gives a recurring problem; is bothering gives the current disturbance.

title.en: A constant leak and a current disturbance

explanation.fa: Have you tried tightening ...? می‌پرسد آیا این راه‌حل را امتحان کرده‌ای. بعد از tried در این سؤال tightening می‌آید. I tried پاسخ می‌دهد که امتحان کرده، ولی ادامهٔ نشتی یعنی موفق نشده؛ امتحان کردن با درست شدن یکی نیست.
explanation.en: Have you tried tightening ...? asks whether a possible solution has been attempted. Tightening follows tried here. I tried confirms the attempt, but the continuing leak shows that trying did not solve it.

example.text: Have you tried tightening the valve with a wrench?

translation.fa: امتحان کرده‌ای با آچار شیر کنترل را سفت کنی؟
translation.en: Have you tried tightening the valve with a wrench?

takeaway.fa: tried + کار با -ing یعنی امتحان کردن یک راه‌حل.
takeaway.en: Tried + an -ing action means testing a possible solution.

title.en: A suspected fault and a risk

explanation.fa: I think نشان می‌دهد فرسودگی واشر تشخیص قطعی متخصص نیست. worn out یعنی بر اثر استفاده فرسوده. can get worse امکان بدترشدن را می‌گوید، نه اینکه حتماً رخ خواهد داد.
explanation.en: I think marks the worn seal as a suspicion, not an expert’s confirmed diagnosis. Worn out means damaged through use. Can get worse states a possibility, not a guaranteed outcome.
